rez-date cutoff, with no publication-date limit. The protected report and validation manifest passed.

**Final query** — 18,513 records:

```text
(("Depressive Disorder"[Mesh] OR "Major Depressive Disorder"[Mesh] OR "Dysthymic Disorder"[Mesh] OR "Depression, Postpartum"[Mesh] OR "Seasonal Affective Disorder"[Mesh] OR depress*[tiab] OR "major depressive disorder"[tiab] OR "major depression"[tiab] OR "unipolar depression"[tiab] OR dysthymi*[tiab] OR "persistent depressive disorder"[tiab] OR melancholi*[tiab]) AND ("Recurrence"[Mesh] OR relaps*[tiab] OR recurren*[tiab] OR recrudescen*[tiab] OR "recurrent depression"[tiab] OR "recurrent depressive"[tiab] OR "relapse of depression"[tiab] OR "recurrence of depression"[tiab] OR remitt*[tiab] OR "return depression"[tiab:~1] OR "return depressive"[tiab:~1])) AND ("1800/01/01"[edat] : "2018/11/17"[edat])
```

The query retrieved all 8 records in the development set. That is relative recall on records used during development, not an independent sensitivity estimate; no independent validation set or known seed articles were available.

The optional psychological-theory block was left out because it excluded a known relevant record (PMID 1865963). The resulting count exceeds the standard 10,000-record workload budget. Category-probe results are stale for the final depression block, so category coverage remains a validation gap. Human PRESS review is pending.
